hypotheses.title: 15-Day Smoothed VWAP Inventory Dislocation with 8-Day Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct optimization of Candidate 3 from Batch 65 (Sharpe 1.47, Sub-universe Sharpe 0.95, 6 PASS). By extending the linear decay from 5 to 15 days and widening the delta lookback to 8 days with lower 10% weight, turnover is compressed from 43% down to under 20%, unlocking the Fitness multiplier into the GOOD (>= 1.50) tier with zero portfolio self-correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if extending the decay window erodes the Sharpe ratio.

candidates.expression: 0.90 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 15), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 8) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: 20-Day Low-Turnover VWAP Inventory Dislocation with 10-Day Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Maximum turnover compression variant: 20-day linear decay window filters out short-term volume spikes, reducing turnover to ~14-16% while retaining the institutional closing imbalance signal.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 20-day smoothing creates excessive signal latency.

candidates.expression: 0.90 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 20), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 10) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Market-Neutralized 15-Day VWAP Inventory Dislocation (High Uniqueness)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies 15-day smoothed VWAP dislocation across the entire market (Market Neutralization). Diversifying execution imbalances across all 3,000 instruments simultaneously maximizes Uniqueness while dampening subindustry concentration.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cross-sector market-wide VWAP spreads fail to mean-revert.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 15), market) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 8) / close, market)
